notes.title: Scheduled Maintenance 10/29-10/31 (Completed!)
notes.content:
Hello there everyone!

The Heart of Crown servers will be down for a planned server maintenance this weekend. There is no definitive end time for the maintenance, but we are expecting to finish on by end-of-day on 10/31 JST. 

During this time, lobby servers and other features will be unavailable. We apologize for any inconvenience. If the maintenance needs to be extended, we will post about it here.

[b]Update (11/1): [/b]Maintenance has been extended on 11/1 and may continue into this week.

[b]Update (11/1): [/b]Maintenance has been completed. All users will need to update to the latest Steam version in order to use the network interface. On certain PC configurations there are some unresolved issues related as state below, and we are still investigating and will continue to endeavor to resolve. 

- Some Windows Input and/or Locale Configurations result in double inputs in text fields. 
- Some network and/or firewall configurations may result in the Ranked Battle or Free Battle modes crashing the game upon input. 

If you experience these problems or any others with this new build please join [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/476420/discussions/0/3160957541901179445/]our discussion thread[/url] for the latest patch and we will do our best to analyze and create any fixes.
